disposition_rows.trigger: No signed branch decision exists; keep no-send and A1 prepared-not-authorized.
disposition_rows.operator_action: Do not transmit. Record no-send or obtain authority.

disposition_rows.trigger: Transmission attempt fails before delivery proof.
disposition_rows.operator_action: Capture failure proof privately and public-shell only the failure class.

disposition_rows.trigger: Message-ID/DSN/delivery status exists without human content.
disposition_rows.operator_action: Treat as transport metadata only; response clock remains unstarted unless separate policy says otherwise.

disposition_rows.trigger: Auto-reply, ticket acknowledgement, bounce processor, or bot response.
disposition_rows.operator_action: Classify as defective/non-human response unless later human-confirmed.

disposition_rows.trigger: Human says decline, do not contact, no capacity, or not interested.
disposition_rows.operator_action: Respect boundary; publish only non-waiver failed-gate shell if appropriate.

disposition_rows.trigger: Human or organization redirects, says wrong route, or names another contact.
disposition_rows.operator_action: Create retarget branch decision; referral is not reviewer appointment.

disposition_rows.trigger: Human agrees only to discuss scope or provide route guidance.
disposition_rows.operator_action: Open scoping lane only; no appointment, finding, custody, or preservation agreement.

disposition_rows.trigger: No human response by the operator-defined expiry date.
disposition_rows.operator_action: Issue expired-no-response shell; no adverse inference, waiver, or status claim.

disposition_rows.trigger: Counterparty asks for raw private records, provider secrets, personal data, or sensitive logs.
disposition_rows.operator_action: Stop public handling; require private custody/legal review and minimal disclosure decision.

gating_rules: prefer failed-gate shell over inference when outcome is decline, referral, auto-ack, delivery-only, failed-send, silence, or private-data request
treat narrow scoping yes as scoping only until reviewer appointment terms are explicit
do not add raw private correspondence to the public release tree by default
do not contact further after a do-not-contact or harassment-risk boundary
public_summary: rev0271 classifies messy reviewer-route outcomes before any public claim. The playbook is prepared only; no contact or response exists.
